title: Fix a failing project (npm test)
prompt: This project has a `package.json` whose `test` script runs the test suite. Running it currently fails. The bug is in `src/calc.js` — the function `average(nums)` divides by the wrong quantity. Read the failing test output, fix `src/calc.js`, and make the project's own check pass. The verification command is `npm test`. Do NOT modify the test file.
